[EN] Spire's Demise
[ES] Caída de la aguja
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} shouldn't be hard to dismantle.
[ES] La {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} no debería ser difícil de desmantelar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Parts of the {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} are critical to our research.
[ES] Partes de la {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} son fundamentales para nuestra investigación.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@creature:46#301} in the {@Rgn:46008$$Raga Kabash Depths}.
[ES] Mata a {@creature:46#301} en la {@Rgn:46008$$Raga Kabash Depths}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Dismantle the {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} in the {@Rgn:46025$$Raga Transmission Room} and collect grellok spire parts.
[ES] Desmantela la {@creature:46#7005#grellok spire} en la {@Rgn:46025$$Raga Transmission Room} y recolecta partes de la aguja grellok.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect grellok spire parts.
[ES] Recolecta partes de la aguja grellok.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to the {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber} and deliver the grellok spire parts to {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian}.
[ES] Regresa a la {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber} y entrégale las partes de la aguja grellok a {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Grellok Spire Parts
[ES] Partes de la aguja grellok
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the grellok spire parts to {@creature:246#1028$$Rhentar} in the {@Rgn:46021$$Strifecore Chamber}.
[ES] Entrégale las partes de la aguja grellok a {@creature:246#1028$$Rhentar} en la {@Rgn:46021$$Strifecore Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I thank you."
[ES] "Te lo agradezco".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
